overview_description.description: Synthesia provides an AI video-generation platform that transforms text into professional videos using customizable avatars and voiceovers in over 140 languages. The service allows users to create, edit, and share videos quickly, making it suitable for various applications like training and marketing. Users can utilize fully cloneable AI video templates and create studio-quality videos directly in their browser.

product.name: Synthesia AI Video Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for creating, editing, managing, and publishing business videos from scripts, documents, links, or ideas using AI avatars, voiceovers, templates, and video-editing tools.

product.name: AI Dubbing and Video Translator
product.description: Tools for translating and dubbing Synthesia videos into more than 160 languages, with synchronized AI voiceovers, captions, and avatar lip movements for localized content.

product.name: Interactive Video and Roleplay Sessions
product.description: Interactive video tools that add viewer interactions, interactive avatars, and AI-powered roleplay scenarios for practice, assessment, and learner engagement.

product.name: Synthesia Enterprise Platform
product.description: Enterprise capabilities for governing AI video production across teams, including workspaces, brand controls, collaboration, access management, publishing, analytics, and content updates.

product.name: Synthesia Services
product.description: Expert services that help organizations plan, create, govern, and scale AI video content and production strategies using the Synthesia platform.

product.name: Synthesia Academy
product.description: An online learning resource offering tutorials and live sessions to help users develop AI video creation skills and apply Synthesia in their organizations.
